title: Sam Darnold: I feel like I got my PhD in football when I went to San Francisco

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sam Darnold: I feel like I got my PhD in football when I went to San Francisco
sources.description: Before Sam Darnold starred at quarterback for the Vikings and won Super Bowl LX with the Seahawks, he spent a year as the 49ers’ backup to Brock Purdy.
